about_the_game:
Journey Quest is the perfect mix of competitive party game and adventure RPG. In Journey Quest, your goal is to traverse from one end of the map to the other faster than your competitors. You journey across the map by selecting locations, each of which has different terrain, difficulty, and options for what you may encounter at the location. You’ll build a party by meeting friends, equip items by finding treasure or buying from merchants, and defeat monsters to earn more gold and experience. You are periodically presented with additional choices, such as random encounters or affinity boosts. As you acquire friends, experience, and items, you will do more damage against monsters and have more beneficial buffs to make your journey easier.

In this way, the skill in Journey Quest is in the choices you make, the risks you take, and the moment you choose to sprint to the end. Journey Quest is played in one sitting as a self-contained adventure. While the game supports computer players, Journey Quest is best enjoyed with a small group of mildly-competitive friends.

Journey Quest includes 3 games, Journey Quest Adventure (fantasy themed), Journey Quest Saga (scifi themed), and Journey Quest Apocalypse. All three games use the same system, making it easy to hop from one to the other.
